entries.title: Eyes on Asia: shaping the global energy transition
entries.summary:
Asia is becoming the decisive arena for the global energy transition. The region is expected to account for most global energy demand growth over the next decade, driven by economic expansion, rising populations, and rising cooling needs linked to climate change. entries.title: What worked: Early wins from South Africa’s first Just Energy Transition Partnership
entries.summary:
Just energy transitions are difficult, especially for emerging economies such as South Africa, where decarbonisation must be balanced with economic development, employment and energy security. Since its launch at COP26 in 2021, the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP) sought to meet this challenge through international finance, political commitment, and coordinated planning.
